narr: Several rounds of early evening thunderstorms on the 24th caused isolated pockets of tree damage across central Indiana with sub-severe hail also across Hendricks county. By late into the evening, a series of storms moved across Knox county with areas of rainfall over 6 inches. Significant flash flooding occurred across the county with a road washed out and water rescues conducted.
ev: A road was washed out by heavy rains along Pine Bluff Road with numerous other roads with high water across the county. Several vehicles were stranded on State Road 67 near Church Road with water rescues conducted. Rainfall amounted to over 6 inches in spots with the highest report north of Vincennes at 6.54 inches.
